You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: In November 2028, how often will the IGEA-PRIM overhead travelling crane at position 13 of the IGEA list, built in 2017, have to be verified?

Facts:
[0] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[1] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[2] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[3] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[4] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[5] prima verifica — verifiedBy — INAIL (INAIL) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[6] full reassessment — hasTimeLimit — every three years (P3Y) [DIR, Annex X]
[7] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[8] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]
[9] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[10] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[11] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[12] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[13] movement of the carrier of machinery serving fixed landings — requiresMeasure — rigidly guided (rigidly guided) [condition: to and at the landings] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.1]
[14] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[15] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[16] machinery serving fixed landings — listedIn — 6.4. (Annex I, point 6.4) [DIR, Annex I, 6.4]
[17] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [condition: hazardous movements of the carrier until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[18] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[19] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[20] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[21] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[22] movement of the machinery — requiresMeasure — must depend on safe positioning (must depend on safe positioning) [condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[23] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[24] successive verifiche — verifiedBy — ARPA (ARPA) [condition: ove ciò sia previsto con legge regionale] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[25] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[26] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[27] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[28] carrier designed as a workstation — requiresMeasure — provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements (provision shall be made to ensure stability and to prevent hazardous movements) [condition: Where the carrier is designed as a workstation] [REG, Annex III, 6.3.2]
[29] 4.1.2.2 machinery running on guide rails — requiresMeasure — devices, which act on the guide rails (devices, which act on the guide rails) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.2]
[30] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device with guard locking controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device with guard locking) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.5]
[31] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[32] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[33] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[34] devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods — listedIn — 14. (annex I, part B, point 14) [condition: involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 14]
[35] original EC declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[36] essential requirement 6.4.3, access to the carrier — requiresMeasure — guards at the landings and on the carrier (guards at the landings and on the carrier) [condition: taking into consideration the foreseeable range of goods and persons to be lifted] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.3]
[37] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[38] Power-operated interlocking movable guards — listedIn — 16. (annex i, part b, point 16) [condition: designed to be used as safeguards in machinery referred to in points 9, 10 and 11 of this Part] [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 16]
[39] tracing log of data generated in relation to an intervention and of safety software versions — retentionPeriod — five years (P5Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[40] lifting machinery marking — requiresMeasure — legible, indelible and in an un-coded form (legible, indelible and in an un-coded form) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[41] 4.1.2.2 residual risk of derailment or rail failure — requiresMeasure — devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment (devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment) [condition: If, despite such devices, there remains a risk of derailment or of failure of a rail or of a running component] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.2]
[42] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[43] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall place only compliant partly completed machinery (shall place only compliant partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 14(1)]
[44] seating — requiresMeasure — it shall not be possible for the machinery to move (not possible for the machinery to move) [condition: where there is a significant risk of roll or tip over and its restraint system is not used] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.2]
[45] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (distributors shall verify that) [condition: Before making partly completed machinery available on the market] [REG, Art. 16(2)]
[46] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[47] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — full quality assurance (full quality assurance) [DIR, Annex X]
[48] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[49] carrier designed as a work station — requiresMeasure — provision must be made to ensure stability (provision must be made to ensure stability) [condition: Where the carrier is designed as a work station] [DIR, Annex I, 6.3.2]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts do not say how often this crane has to be verified. Nothing in them gives the IGEA list, position 13, or a verification interval for overhead travelling cranes. Fact 8 (D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 71, c. 13, 'entro dodici mesi') concerns a time limit for the modalities of periodic verifications, not their frequency.","used":[8]}
